_doc: The Undertow's Reach (act1/undertows_reach.md; final pass M3-CRB-007): water (the forearm, the palm and the digits' cores: black storm-water, slate streaks, foam crests, the door-sized wounds), crust (the crust plates, claws and keel spurs, barnacles, the drowned spawn bodies), wreck (masts, yard, planks, the wheel, chain, rope, the lantern). wet_darken 0.55 on water (was 0.2, which crushed the vertex colours to black). The storm's own water look is the PC GPU session's; this is the creature-shader stand-in. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
